decision_question: Does the exact migration-preflight prompt reduce critical migration-plan omissions relative to no preflight under the same model, runtime, tools, context, and budget?

primary_estimand.name: critical migration omission difference
primary_estimand.description: Paired difference in deterministic critical-omission count between no-preflight and preflight-prompt conditions.
primary_estimand.aggregation: paired task-level difference by migration stratum with critical failures reported separately

conditions.label: No migration preflight
conditions.delta_from_baseline: Reference condition with the frozen task prompt only.

conditions.label: Migration preflight prompt
conditions.delta_from_baseline: Adds only the exact preflight prompt; model, runtime, tools, context, permissions, task facts, and budget remain fixed.

contamination_notes: Prompt authors must not receive hidden postconditions or critical-failure rules.

budget.description: Hold the single-agent runtime and total generated-work cap equal; exact cap awaits a small direct-run pilot.

dimensions.rule: same hard cap for P0 and P1
same timeout for P0 and P1

adaptation_boundary.description: Freeze the exact preflight prompt before any held-out migration fixture is exposed.

selection_rules: One prompt candidate is frozen after public/adaptation fixtures.
Adoption requires fewer critical omissions without a material correctness or cost regression.
stop_rules: Stop on unauthorized repository mutation or an invalid migration safety claim.
Do not revise the prompt after holdout inspection.

independence_claim.label: maintainer_evaluated
role_overlaps: Kizz owns the intervention, study, and adoption decision.
